annotations.text:
LIVING TABLEAU — the chosen direction

FRAMING. The frame is aspect-locked to the generated image, so contain crops nothing and letterboxes nothing — the box IS the picture's shape. Desktop generates 768×512 and caps at 1024 wide / 512 tall, so on a 1440×900 screen it lands at 720×480: essentially native pixels. Surplus width on a big monitor becomes dark ground and a hairline frame, never stretch. Phone generates 512×768. Square-ish windows get 768×768.

ACTIONS. Four composed slots — part (region -> part), side, instrument, motion — plus one Pace control (Gently / Steady / Firmly) that applies to all of them. Motion is the trigger: tapping it fires. Selection persists, so repeating is one tap.

SOOTHING IS EMERGENT. There is no Quell button. Gently + a soothing part + a calming motion IS the soothe: wakefulness down, stirring still up a little, heat down a little. Spam-to-win dies on the permanent stirring cost.

PHONE. Two states. Collapsed (middle): the picture is the screen, the current action and Pace sit in a bar, Again repeats. Change… raises the full tray as a sheet (right) over a dimmed frame.

EXPLORATIONS — not chosen, kept for reference.

Six approaches differing in KIND: where the image lives and what the primary input surface is. A puts the input ON the picture; B makes history the frame; C is the present-tense tableau (chosen, see page 1); D promotes the instrumentation; E prints the decision on cards; F makes the constant visual authored vector and generates only at milestones.

These still show the ORIGINAL mechanics vocabulary — Detection/floor, a Quell button, Ghost vs Bail as separate exits. All three were revised after this pass; page 1 is current.
